insights: 412K followers but recent posts (post 4 @ 7w) get 25 likes = 0.006% engagement rate. Pinned posts (post 1-3) carry the social proof signal.

Hashtag strategy is split: 4/8 brand-self-referential (#LaylaAI, #LaylaTripPlanner), 4/8 category (#TripPlanner, #AIPlanner). Zero broad-travel tags (#travel, #wanderlust). Strategy is brand-search recall, not reach.
Like counts are HIDDEN on all posts. They use the public Instagram 'Hide like counts' feature.
Voice: warm, conversational, heavy emoji use, long-form captions. Direct contrast with our editorial-restrained voice + single ✦ glyph.
Caption pattern: specific big numbers (1.2M trips, +1.7M trips planned) used as proof IN captions, not just bio.
Recent format: 7-slide carousel for World Cup 2026 trend-jumping content. Trend-relevance is a deliberate cadence lever.
Confirmed: their bio CTA points to app.layla.ai/download — they convert to MOBILE APP installs, not web. Our 'geknee.com' CTA is a web conversion — different funnel.
Caption hook of post 1 uses '47 tabs won't close themselves' — same pain frame as our A1 V1 ('47 tabs. Sticky notes. A maybe Tokyo? that turns into nothing'). Direct overlap. Differentiate harder.
